method: Read current primary authority pages with web tool; compare selected source scripts. This is factual verification, not a video editorial approval.

checks.facts: For results received 9 October 2026, complete review case is due 30 October. Panel has two grammar heads and one primary head. Later results have a separate three-week window. Preserve restriction against posting this unlabelled advice after the main October window.
School-specific lower-score pupil-premium route and usual catchment requirement, evidence to schools by 31 October. Can request a selection review separately.
Most grammar address cut-off 1 September, some earlier. Non-Bucks pupils including Milton Keynes register themselves in May/June. Apply for schools through home authority by 31 October.

Unwell children should not take the test. State-funded Bucks and Partner school pupils may test later in school. Other pupils need independent evidence within three working days for one alternative date. Started incomplete papers cannot be resat.
